room_rent.note: Up to SI; no room rent sub-limit mentioned for Vital Plan

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit specified; covered up to SI

copayment.display: None (age-based co-pay if first entry at 60+)
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay for entry below 60. 20% for entry age 60-64, 25% for 65-69, 30% for 70-74, 40% for 75+ (first-time entrants only)

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹1L/eye
sub_limits.note: Cataract surgery: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹1,00,000/eye. Maternity sub-limits apply. Domiciliary capped at 10% of SI.

deductible.note: Voluntary deductible available as optional; base has none

ped_waiting.note: 50% liability in 3rd year, 100% from 4th year onwards

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most listed conditions); 36 months for joint replacement/organ transplant

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait for self / 24mo for spouse)
maternity.note: Normal delivery ₹15,000; LSCS ₹25,000. Pre/post-natal hospitalisation NOT covered under Vital Plan. 4 continuous annual premiums required for self (36 months), 3 for spouse (24 months).

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of base SI. Reduced by 50% of SI in year following a claim.

restoration.note: Triggered only after full SI + cumulative bonus exhausted. Cannot be used for same illness already claimed in that year, or maternity. Unrelated illnesses only effectively.

domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.); minimum 3-day treatment required

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy; inpatient only; OPD excluded

ambulance.note: Fixed limit for Vital Plan regardless of network/non-network

modern_treatments.note: Day-care list includes robotic/advanced procedures; no explicit modern treatment sub-limit stated

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items listed in Annexure III are excluded

global_cover.note: Medical treatment abroad only available under Premiere Plan

notable_exclusions: Stem cell storage, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), hormone replacement therapy, non-prescribed drugs, refractive error <7.5D, infertility/ART
